resources.string: Choose an image from your device and view it on a focused, dark canvas.

Your choice
Open images with the system file picker.

Focus on the image
Fit the whole image on screen without cropping.
Use Yue on its own or as an image plugin in Giant Explorer.

01 Choose an image
Return home and tap Choose an image.

02 View the picture
The image fits the available screen space.

03 Browse in Giant
Import the Yue plugin and open an image from the file menu. Swipe when multiple images are available.
